js: wp.apiFetch({path:"/wc/v3/payments/accounts"}).then(a => { const all = new Set(); Object.values(a.capability_requirements || {}).forEach(l => l.forEach(x => all.add(x))); return {country: a.country, status: a.status, is_live: a.is_live, default_currency: a.store_currencies && a.store_currencies.default, all_requirements: [...all].sort(), card_payments: (a.capability_requirements || {}).card_payments, transfers: (a.capability_requirements || {}).transfers}; })
